stories.title: Driver spared jail after Christmas Eve smash on ‘Kinnerton Bumps’ left three injured
stories.summary: A 19-year-old driver has been given a suspended sentence after a Christmas Eve collision on a road near Pen-y-ffordd left three of his passengers seriously injured.
